title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover and backoff ordering
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: During last week's incident we observed the SLO enforcer enter a backoff->failover->immediate-backoff cycle in some regions when load spiked and downstream capacity temporarily dropped. That thrashing caused unnecessary regional failovers and increased tail latency for affected customers. This hotfix stabilizes the enforcer by introducing deterministic backoff ordering, a short hysteresis window before triggering regional failover, and improved coordination between circuit-breaker state transitions and load-shedding. Summary of changes: 1) Enforcer: add an ordered backoff queue so regions back off in a predictable order instead of simultaneously; 2) Hysteresis: require a sustained breach for 10s (configurable) before escalating to regional failover; 3) Circuit breaker: add safety checks to prevent immediate re-arming for 30s after a failover; 4) Load-shedding: smooth threshold adjustments to avoid oscillation when moving between bursty and steady traffic; 5) Metrics/alerts: emit a new metric slo_enforcer.failover_reason with labels and wire that into existing runbook; 6) Tests: unit + integration + e2e scenarios that reproduce the thrashing pattern. Checklist: - [x] Reproduced issue in local perf-canary harness - [x] Added unit and integration tests - [x] Added e2e scenario to perf-canary and validated stability - [x] Updated runbook (docs/slo/enforcer-runbook.md) - [x] Coordinated rollout with SRE oncall Plan: Gradual rollout to non-prod then staged production rollout by region (EU, NA, APAC) with monitoring window after each stage. Rollback: revert head branch or set enforcer.feature_flags.disable_regional_failover = true. Related: ENG-2121 for long-term enforcer refactor, SUP-4452 customer impact ticket. Notes: I intentionally kept hysteresis and re-arm intervals configurable via the enforcer config so we can tune without code changes. Technical details: The root cause was simultaneous backoff decisions across replica workers due to use of a non-deterministic map iteration combined with a short re-arm timer. Fix replaces map iteration with a prioritized queue seeded from region latency/throughput scores and gates state transitions with a per-region token bucket that prevents rapid toggles. This preserves SLOs while avoiding cascading failovers.
